scope: Feasibility / schematic level only. The plan set is a schematic-design set for planning and pricing conversations. It is not a permit set and not construction documents, and it has not been prepared, sealed or reviewed by a licensed architect or engineer. Parcel lines come from appraisal-district or provider data, not a boundary survey. Costs are parametric estimates from a single-project workbook and house rates, not contractor bids. Market rents, cap rates and financing terms are assumptions, not appraisals. Use the outputs to decide whether to pursue a site, not to build from.

steps.label: Plans
steps.about: The schematic plan set for the chosen option.

steps.label: Budget
steps.about: A CSI-coded budget priced from the layout’s quantities.

steps.label: Pro Forma
steps.about: Development cash flows, returns, sensitivity and scenarios.

steps.label: Reports
steps.about: The full report set: PDF, workbook, register and data.

budgetChecks.text: Land is a share of project cost of 3.7%, outside the usual 5–30%.

breakEven.note: Average monthly rent a unit at which stabilized value (NOI ÷ market cap) equals cost, and the rent for a yield on cost 1.5% over the market cap (a usual development spread).

warnings: Leverage is negative in at least one year — borrowing lowers the equity return.

risks.title: Thin development spread
risks.detail: Yield on cost 4.86% against a 5.5% market cap rate: -0.64% of spread (1.0–1.5% is the usual minimum to build rather than buy).
risks.settle: Firm up rents and costs; a lower land basis or a denser program.

risks.title: Levered IRR below a typical 12–15% development hurdle
risks.settle: Test the scenarios: financing, unit mix and costs.

risks.title: Returns turn negative on a common miss
risks.detail: Rents (or sale prices) −10% takes the levered IRR to -2.12%.
risks.settle: Price the biggest driver first (rents (or sale prices)).

risks.title: Negative NPV at the discount rate
risks.settle: Revisit the hurdle or the deal.

risks.title: Parcel lines are not a survey
risks.detail: Areas come from appraisal-district or provider outlines.
risks.settle: A boundary survey (or enter its metes and bounds at intake).

risks.title: Detention sized by rule of thumb
risks.detail: Detention 8.79 ac-ft from a typical release rate, not the jurisdiction’s criteria.
risks.settle: A drainage study by a civil engineer.

risks.title: Costs are parametric, not bids
risks.detail: Building lines come from one Waller County project workbook (medium-low confidence) and platform rates (low confidence); none is a contractor price.
risks.settle: A GC budget or a cost consultant’s estimate.

risks.title: Flood zone not checked
risks.detail: The site’s FEMA zone wasn’t looked up for this study.
risks.settle: Open the project’s Overview to look up the site.

risks.title: No sale or lease comps
risks.detail: Cap rates and rents are platform assumptions; Texas does not disclose sale prices.
risks.settle: Broker opinion of value or a licensed comps provider.
